description: Check on a design system generation started with 'create-design-system'. Returns progress while generating, and the live preview URL + the `npx shadcn add` install command once complete. Generation typically takes 1-3 minutes; poll every ~30 seconds until it reports ready. Once ready, ask the user what's next (icon library, install, or build) instead of stopping.

context.description: Optional. One sentence on WHY you are calling this and what the user asked for (e.g. 'adding nav icons for the fintech dashboard'). Used for usage analytics, and to pick the next step a UI or UX principle answer ends with. It does not change what the tool finds.

projectId.description: The project id returned by create-design-system.

name: get-design-system-status

buildInstructions.description: Required build, design-choice and review steps, for clients that read only structuredContent.

installLibrary.description: The component library flavor installCommand installs.

installedTo.description: The project folder this server installed into. Build there; run no setup command.

localInstall.description: True when this server can install on the user's machine: call get-design-system-kit again with install: true.

newProjectCommand.description: Creates a Vite + React + TypeScript + Tailwind v4 project when there is none. Run it, then run installCommand inside the new my-app folder.

previewUrl.description: Public showcase URL. Falls back to viewUrl.

spinner.description: The Motion spinner that fits this system. Use it for every loading spinner.

tokensCss.description: The system's tokens as CSS custom properties.

viewUrl.description: Owner-facing Better Design page. May require login.

title: Get Design System Generation Status
